production.note: US model years 2021 and 2023 onward; there was no 2022 model. Start: Dodge, 26 August 2020: 'The Durango SRT Hellcat is scheduled to be built exclusively for the 2021 model year.' Return: Dodge's 2023 Durango specification sheet lists the SRT Hellcat (dodge-durango-2023-specs). Motor Authority (Viknesh Vijayenthiran, 6 Sep 2023): it 'went away after one year. But due to popular demand, Dodge revived it for the 2023 model year' (motorauthority-durango-hellcat-2024). ClubAlfa (2 June 2025) reports Dodge confirming 'the return of the Durango SRT HELLCAT for another year' (clubalfa-durango-hellcat-2026); AutoGuide (Michael Accardi, 2 June 2025) on the 2026 model (autoguide-durango-hellcat-2026); Edmunds lists a 2026 SRT Hellcat (edmunds-durango-hellcat-2026). endYear null: still on sale. (Sources as opened on 2026-10-03 for the earlier draft.)

drivetrain.note: Transfer case MP3010, 'Single-speed, electronic proportioning', 'Full-time AWD'.

transmission.note: '8HP95 TORQUEFLITE AUTOMATIC, EIGHT-SPEED OVERDRIVE', the only transmission.

powerHp.note: Quote (Dodge 2021 specification sheet): "Power 710 bhp (529 kW) @ 6,100 rpm". The 2023 sheet: "Power (est.) (SAE J2723) 710 hp (529 kW) @ 6,100 rpm" (dodge-durango-2023-specs). Edmunds 2023 and 2026 SRT Hellcat: "Horsepower | 710 hp @ 6,100 rpm". The rating is unchanged across the run. Dodge's 2023 sheet also labels power "(est.)": "Power (est.) (SAE J2723) 710 hp (529 kW) @ 6,100 rpm".

weightLb.note: PROVISIONAL (manufacturer estimate plus database). 2023 SRT Hellcat (AWD, the only configuration). Quote (Dodge 2023 specification sheet, table headed "WEIGHTS (ESTIMATES)"): "SRT Hellcat | 6.2-liter | 7,100 (3,221) | 5,575 (2,529) | 1,590 (721)" (GVWR, curb weight lb (kg), payload). Edmunds agrees for 2023 ("Curb Weight | 5,575 lbs.", edmunds-durango-hellcat-2023) and 2026 ("Curb weight | 5,575 lbs.", edmunds-durango-hellcat-2026). Dodge's 2021 sheet, also headed "WEIGHTS (Estimates)", gave 5,710 lb (dodge-durango-2021-specs); there was no 2022 model.

discrepancies.reason: Model year. Dodge's 2021 sheet gives 5,710 lb and its 2023 sheet 5,575 lb (same GVWR and payload, 7,100 and 1,590 lb); both are under a 'WEIGHTS (Estimates)' heading. Edmunds gives 5,575 lb for 2023 and 2026.
discrepancies.resolution: Reference year 2023, the first year with the 5,575 lb figure that later years keep; both figures are estimates, so the weight is provisional.

provisionalNote: Weight (5,575 lb) rests on Dodge's 2023 specification sheet, whose weights are headed 'WEIGHTS (ESTIMATES)', and on Edmunds (database) for 2023 and 2026, which agree. A final (non-estimate) Dodge curb weight for a 2023 or later Durango SRT Hellcat, or a major magazine's specification panel, would replace it. Note that Dodge's 2021 estimate was 5,710 lb and there was no 2022 model.
